answer: Beneath each beacon a marble waits, and at zenith the light casts its shadow on the ground. Every identity backs its claim with a 1,000,000 POA stake. Two marbles casting the same shadow belong to one operator: both rewards burn, both stakes pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 700,000 POA fine per fake. One fake costs 1,700,000 POA, and eight fakes cost 13,600,000 POA before any payout clears.
